principle: Attack the binding constraint first: eligibility, then a warm path, then visible proof of work, then a tailored application.

actions.title: Map your LinkedIn network onto the three target organisations
actions.why: D3 starts from knowing who you already know.

actions.title: Ask Jordan Sample for the introduction to the Globex AI Success lead, and send route-eval first
actions.why: Turns an agreed path (D3 2) into a named insider who knows your work (D3 3).
actions.done_when: The AI Success lead has replied and seen route-eval (email)

actions.title: Publish the scheduling rollout case study with numbers your former manager has checked
actions.why: One corroborated, public proof-of-work piece lifts D2 for most best-fit roles.
actions.done_when: Case study is live and the referee has confirmed the numbers

actions.title: Fix the LinkedIn headline: 'led a team of 40' should say 'led a team of 8'
actions.why: Overclaims hurt credibility more than gaps. Fix before any application goes out.
actions.done_when: Headline changed (screenshot or link), claim C001 re-checked as supported

actions.title: Tailor your resume and cover note for the Initech fleet deployments role
actions.why: A tailored application lifts D7 for the best-fit role.
actions.done_when: Tailored resume and cover note saved in campaign/drafts/

actions.title: Apply to the Initech Robotics fleet deployments role once A04 is done
actions.why: Best fit of all open roles. Apply after the headline fix so the profiles match.

actions.title: Ask your three closest logistics contacts whether they know anyone at Initech Robotics
actions.why: Initech has four matching roles and no warm path (D3 0). An agreed second-degree path is D3 2.
actions.done_when: Someone has agreed to introduce you to a person at Initech (email or message)

actions.title: Answer the notice period and non-compete question (Q01)
actions.why: Confirms the earliest start date and that no role is off limits.
actions.done_when: Answer recorded in intake/answers.md and evidence.json

actions.title: Start a weekly newsletter on AI in operations
actions.done_when: Three issues sent and at least 50 subscribers

actions.title: Build a small route-eval demo for Acme AI's quarterly evaluation challenge
actions.why: An Acme-specific piece of work is the D4 edge most applicants lack.

actions.title: Go to the Initech warehouse operators meetup in Melbourne
actions.why: Meets Initech staff in person; a possible warm path.
actions.done_when: Met at least one Initech employee who has seen your work (follow-up email)

backlog: Product roles at Globex and Initech: revisit after six months of product-adjacent work (WT2).
A second public talk, once the case study has had a month to circulate.

experiments_log.result: 1 contact at Acme AI, 2 at Globex Labs, 0 at Initech Robotics.
experiments_log.why: D3 rose from 0 to 1 at Acme and Globex.

experiments_log.result: 3 issues, 9 subscribers, no change in D5 or any metric over 3 runs.
experiments_log.why: The case study moved D2 more for less time.

experiments_log.result: D2 rose from 2 to 3 on the two Initech roles.
experiments_log.why: Keep: corroborated proof works. Plan a second piece later.
